notes: Jilan Sehat Card v1.0: Sehat Sahulat Program (Government of Pakistan) helper — one-tap eligibility check by SMS to 8500 (type your own 13-digit CNIC, no dashes), guide cards on the program, how treatment works and coverage, plus a WhatsApp service card. No portal button or helpline in v1.0: no official portal could be verified at build time. The app collects and saves nothing.
